errors.text: The proposed Mo-alloying intervention does not reconstruct the target intervention of spark-plasma sintering MgAlTiVFeCo powder at 1000 °C.
Mo is a high-density element, so retaining low density is not credible without a specified Mo fraction and a calculated or measured density limit.
No quantitative composition, processing route, corrosion environment, oxidation temperature, or mechanical-performance criterion is specified.
The cited evidence mainly concerns coatings and refractory HEAs and does not establish simultaneous mechanical, corrosion, oxidation, and low-density benefits in a lightweight bulk HEA.
No cited evidence directly supports improved high-temperature oxidation resistance from Mo addition.
The falsification experiment lacks matched controls, numerical success thresholds, and a rule addressing tradeoffs among density, strength, corrosion, and oxidation.
